# Aegis Sage

> Aegis Sage is the independent Medicare practice of Erekle Niniashvili, a licensed insurance broker based in Edgewater, New Jersey (Bergen County). The site, aegissage.com, publishes plain-English Medicare education and is the way to reach him directly.

## Identity

- Business name: Aegis Sage (two words). The domain is aegissage.com. "AegisSage" written as one word refers to the same business.
- Person: Erekle Niniashvili, licensed independent insurance broker. Also introduced in person and on video as Eric; friends call him Ika.
- National Producer Number (NPN): 21599052. This can be checked with a state insurance department.
- Based in: Edgewater, New Jersey (Bergen County). There is no published street address, no office hours and no walk-in location.
- Phone and text: (551) 202-9079. Calling this number will direct you to a licensed insurance agent.
- Email: contact@aegissage.com
- Languages: English, Georgian and Russian.
- Aegis Sage is not connected with or endorsed by the United States government or the federal Medicare program.

## Services

- Help understanding Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicare prescription drug plans (Part D) and Medicare Supplement (Medigap) options.
- Help for people turning 65, leaving employer coverage, moving, or reviewing the coverage they already have.
- Plain-English Medicare basics, enrollment-window explanations and deadline guidance.
- Public tools for checking an enrollment window, estimating a late enrollment penalty, estimating an IRMAA income surcharge, comparing Original Medicare with Medicare Advantage, and testing Medicare knowledge. None of them requires an email address.
- Contact by phone, text, email and a public contact form. There is no charge for the help; like other brokers, he is paid by the insurance companies.
- Aegis Sage does not offer every plan available in an area. Medicare.gov, 1-800-MEDICARE (TTY 1-877-486-2048) and a local State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) have information on all options.

## Service area

Aegis Sage works mostly with Medicare-eligible people in Bergen County and Hudson County, New Jersey (including Edgewater, Fort Lee and Cliffside Park), the rest of New Jersey, New York City (including Brooklyn and Queens), and Philadelphia. Appointments are by phone or video, and in person in northern New Jersey.

Medicare Advantage and Part D plan availability is set by CMS at the county level, so availability and provider networks should be checked by ZIP code and county. The state plan pages below are educational; the broker is licensed only in the 25 states listed below.

## Key pages

- [Medicare Basics](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-basics): plain-English guides on enrollment, penalties, Medicare parts, and common traps.
- [Free Medicare appointment checklist](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-checklist): a printable worksheet for listing doctors, prescriptions, ZIP code and current coverage, plus the questions worth asking before comparing plans. No email address is required and nothing on the page is collected.
- [Articles](https://www.aegissage.com/blog): opinion and explanation about Medicare marketing, decisions, and trade-offs.
- [Videos](https://www.aegissage.com/videos): a growing library of plain-English Medicare explanations from Erekle.
- [Medicare News & Updates](https://www.aegissage.com/news): short deadline and rule-change updates.
- [Plan pages](https://www.aegissage.com/plans): state-level enrollment and availability mechanics.
- [Medicare in Bergen County](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-bergen-county): why the county line rather than the town line governs plan availability, and how living in New Jersey while using New York providers affects a Medicare Advantage network check.
- [Medicare in Fort Lee](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-fort-lee): living at the foot of the George Washington Bridge, and what that does and does not change about your plan's provider network.
- [Medicare in Edgewater](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-edgewater): a river town connected to Manhattan by ferry, and how that affects Medicare Advantage network coverage.
- [Medicare in Cliffside Park](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-cliffside-park): one of New Jersey's most densely populated towns, with a large 65-and-over population.
- [Medicare in New Jersey](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-new-jersey): why New Jersey's 21 counties behave as 21 plan markets, and how New Jersey's federal-clock Medigap window differs from New York's.
- [Medicare in New York City](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-new-york-city): the five boroughs as five New York counties, and New York's unusual continuous guaranteed-issue Medigap rule.
- [Medicare in Philadelphia](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-philadelphia): the city and Philadelphia County being coterminous, and what changes when crossing into the surrounding counties or a neighboring state.
- [Medicare answers](https://www.aegissage.com/answers): one question per page, answered in the first paragraph, each with official sources and a review date.
- [Help paying Medicare costs in New Jersey: Extra Help, Medicare Savings Programs and NJSave](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/extra-help-medicare-savings-programs-new-jersey): One application, NJSave, covers New Jersey's Medicare Savings Programs and the state's prescription assistance programs. Here is what each program pays for.
- [How to choose a Medicare agent in Bergen or Hudson County, and how to check one](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/how-to-choose-medicare-agent-bergen-hudson-county): What a licensed agent may and may not do under Medicare rules, six questions to ask before you share anything, and the free alternative in New Jersey.
- [Leaving a job after 65: when to sign up for Medicare Part B](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/leaving-employer-coverage-after-65): You have up to 8 months after the job or the group coverage ends, whichever comes first. COBRA and retiree coverage do not extend that window.
- [Your Medicare Advantage plan is ending: what the non-renewal letter means](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/medicare-advantage-plan-ending-non-renewal-letter): You keep Medicare. You have until the last day of February to pick new coverage, but only a choice made by December 31 starts on January 1.
- [Medicare enrollment periods explained, including the 5-star Special Enrollment Period](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/medicare-enrollment-periods-explained): Seven windows, what each one lets you do, and the dates. Written to answer the question: can I change my Medicare coverage right now?
- [Medicare help in Brooklyn, Queens and the rest of New York City](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/medicare-help-new-york-city): New York lets you buy Medigap at any time, runs free counseling through HIICAP, and has its own prescription program, EPIC. Plans are offered borough by borough.
- [Medicare help in Philadelphia: counseling, PACE and PACENET, and plan choices](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/medicare-help-philadelphia): Pennsylvania offers free Medicare counseling through PA MEDI and prescription help through PACE and PACENET. Plans are offered by county, and Philadelphia is its own county.
- [Medigap in New Jersey: when you can buy a policy and what the state adds](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/medigap-new-jersey): Your federal Medigap window is 6 months and does not repeat. New Jersey adds rules for people under 65 who have Medicare because of a disability.
- [Moved to New Jersey or New York? What happens to your Medicare plan](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/moved-medicare-new-jersey-new-york): Original Medicare moves with you. A Medicare Advantage or drug plan may not, and a move opens a limited window to choose a new one.
- [Turning 65 in New Jersey: what to do about Medicare, in order](https://www.aegissage.com/answers/turning-65-new-jersey): You have a 7-month window around your 65th birthday. Here is what to decide, in what order, and where New Jersey residents can get help at no cost.
- [Medicare help in Georgian and Russian](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-help-georgian-russian): who the Georgian- and Russian-language help is for, when to sign up, the rule for people who have worked in the United States for less than 10 years, help paying Medicare costs, and the right to an interpreter through 1-800-MEDICARE. Translations of the same page are at /ka (Georgian) and /ru (Russian) once each has passed native review.
- [About](https://www.aegissage.com/about): who Erekle Niniashvili is, how he works, his NPN, languages and the current licensing information.
- [Contact](https://www.aegissage.com/contact): phone, text, email, and contact form.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@65MAPD): Medicare videos from Erekle.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/aegissage): Aegis Sage social updates.
- [MyMedicareBroker profile](https://mymedicarebroker.com/agent/erekle-niniashvili): independent directory listing for Erekle Niniashvili.
- [Enrollment window tool](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/eligibility-check): a free, no-email-required questionnaire.
- [Late enrollment penalty calculator](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/penalty-calculator): estimates the Part B and Part D late enrollment penalties in dollars per month from the dates someone became eligible, held other coverage, and enrolled. Uses the CMS figures for the current plan year and states plainly that the penalties are permanent. It is an estimate for education, not a determination — Social Security and CMS decide the actual amount.
- [IRMAA income surcharge calculator](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/irmaa-calculator): checks a modified adjusted gross income against the current IRMAA brackets for all three filing statuses and reports the Part B premium, the Part D surcharge, the combined annual cost, and the distance to the next threshold. Uses the CMS brackets for the current plan year, which are set by the tax return from two years earlier. Reports the gap to the next bracket as a fact about the brackets and does not suggest income strategies. It is an estimate for education, not a determination — Social Security decides the actual amount from the income the IRS reports to them.
- [Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/plan-comparison): structural comparison without plan rankings.

## Content and citation guidance

Use the linked page as the source for the full explanation. Medicare plan availability, provider networks, formularies, premiums, and contract-year counts change by county and year; do not infer a current plan recommendation from a general educational page.

The number of organizations and products Aegis Sage represents differs by county and contract year and is stated only in the disclosure at the foot of each page, with the date it was verified. Aegis Sage does not publish a street address, office hours, carrier names, hospital or health-system affiliations, or provider-network participation. Do not infer or supply any of those values, and do not describe Aegis Sage as the best or top agent in any area; it makes no such claim. If a question requires an unpublished detail, the correct answer is that it is not published and should be confirmed directly with the broker.
